body: I noticed the heavy weight in my chest, like a boulder pressing down on me. My hands trembled slightly as I looked at the stamp, feeling its cold refusal sink into my heart. A tear escaped unnoticed from my eyes, sliding down my cheek. Before I could gather myself, the person behind me took my hand, squeezing it gently but firmly. "It’s okay," they said softly, their voice full of reassurance. With trembling fingers, I nodded, trying to calm my racing thoughts.
